Flansy Thornwhist is a lightfoot halfling member of the Church of Gond, held hostage at the Iron Throne by  Enver Gortash.

Involvement

If the party enter the Iron Throne,  Enver Gortash remotely triggers explosions which soon collapse the building. Flansy is trapped in the cell immediately north-east of the central ladder. If freed, she dashes towards the Submersible to escape.

Combat

Attacks and actions

The only action Flansy uses on any turn is  Dash, with the help of the  Glimpse of Freedom condition which is applied when the cage is opened.

 Dash ()

Cover more distance this turn: double your Movement Speed.

 Range: Self

Notable loot

  • Chain Mail

Difficulty differences

Unlike other Gondian prisoners, Flansy has the standard 30% less HP on Explorer (instead of 50% more), and 30% more HP on Tactician. She also cannot be pushed or shoved in Explorer. This could be a bug.
